_comment: The one place Hypurr's plans are configured. The host serves this to the apps (method `pricing`) and the website copies it at build time. Prices are in rupees; null means not decided yet. Change numbers here only.
gstNote: Prices exclude GST. GST rate and GSTIN: to be confirmed before launch.

plans.name: Free
plans.summary: For trying Hypurr on your own laptop.

plans.name: Pro
plans.summary: For one person who works from their phone every day.
features: Ticket to PR, Fix from a log, Write tests

plans.name: Team
plans.summary: For teams that need IT sign-off and a manager console.

payments._comment: Android: RevenueCat over Google Play Billing (app user id = gateway subject id). Web later: Razorpay. Stripe is off (PAYMENTS_STRIPE=1 on the Worker turns its old routes back on).

creditPacks._comment: Hypurr credits for paid gateway models, sold as Google Play consumables via RevenueCat. productId must match the Play Console in-app product id and the RevenueCat product. creditsCents is what the gateway grants (USD cents of model usage) after Google's 15% fee and 18% GST, with margin.
